desc:
Huh... we can draw a real line of connection between Miko and Shō here – [**Chōgosonshiji**](https://www.visitnara.jp/venues/A00509/) or [**Mt. Shigi**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Shigi). The temple was built by Prince Shōtoku because he prayed to Bishamonten for victory here in the year of the **Tiger**, on the day of the **Tiger**, and at the hour of the **Tiger**.

Yeah, so that's the association with the **Tiger**. 🤔 And so in a way, Miko started the Bishamonten cult following that Byakuren is part of.
